items.title: Exercise special termination right (§ 57 Abs. 1 TKG) over the price increase
items.quote: Dieses Recht können Sie innerhalb von drei Monaten ausüben, nachdem Ihnen diese Mitteilung zugegangen ist; der Vertrag endet dann frühestens mit dem Tag, an dem die Preiserhöhung wirksam wird.
items.computation: The letter is from a company (telecom provider), not an authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery period applies (§ 130 Abs. 1 BGB: a declaration to a private party takes effect on actual arrival, not a fixed number of days after posting). The exact day the letter arrived at the recipient's address is not stated, so the earliest plausible start is the letter's own date, 13.04.2026 (Monday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of arrival is not counted, so the 3-month period begins 14.04.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of months ends with the day of the last month that bears the same number as the start day: three months after 13.04.2026 is 13.07.2026, a Monday, which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Because the actual arrival date is unknown and typically a few days after posting, the true last day could fall a few days later than 13.07.2026; the date below is the earliest plausible (most conservative) last day.
